description: Open-source package vulnerability check via OSV.dev for npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist and more, by ecosystem+name+version, purl, or up to 10 purls. Useful before installing or upgrading a dependency. Returns vulnerable flag, count, CVE/GHSA aliases, CVSS score and severity, fixed versions and a verified upgradeTo version. Errors: 400 invalid input, 502 OSV unavailable. PAID: $0.002 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/osv/package.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem, case-insensitive: npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Hex, Pub, Debian:12 ...

limit.description: max vulns returned per package, default 50

name.description: package name; Maven uses groupId:artifactId, Go uses the module path

version.description: optional exact version; omit for all known advisories

name: osv_package_vulns
title: Package vulnerability check (OSV.dev)
